categories.main_business_segments: Shengyi Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of various types of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its product portfolio targets mid-to-high-end markets and includes communication equipment boards, network equipment boards, computer/server boards, automotive electronics boards, consumer electronics boards, industrial control and medical boards, and aerospace boards.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced PCB manufacturing technologies such as high-density interconnect (HDI), multi-layer PCB fabrication, embedded capacitor technology, heat dissipation techniques, graded gold finger manufacturing, micro-via and micro-blind via technology, mixed lamination, and high-frequency signal loss control. It also employs laser drilling, multi-layer Z-axis alignment, and high-speed optical module PCB production technologies, maintaining a strong R&D focus with numerous patents and industry standards participation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shengyi Electronics serves key industries including telecommunications, networking, computing/servers, automotive electronics, consumer electronics, industrial control, medical devices, and aerospace. Its major customers are leading enterprises in these sectors, with a significant focus on AI servers, high-end network switches, satellite communications, and automotive intelligent driving systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with manufacturing bases in Dongguan and Ji'an, and has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Thailand, and other international locations. It maintains a global sales network serving domestic and overseas markets, with export sales accounting for a substantial portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shengyi Electronics operates in the midstream of the electronics supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of customized printed circuit boards that are critical components for downstream electronic product manufacturers. It procures raw materials such as copper-clad laminates, semi-cured sheets, and copper foil from upstream suppliers and delivers finished PCBs directly to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on high-end PCB products for AI computing, 5G communications, satellite internet, automotive electronics, and new energy sectors. It has multiple ongoing R&D projects targeting next-generation network technologies, high-frequency PCBs, and automotive high-voltage system PCBs, aiming to maintain technological leadership and expand market share.
categories.revenue_model: Shengyi Electronics generates revenue primarily through the sale of customized printed circuit boards produced on a make-to-order basis. It employs a direct sales model complemented by limited distribution, providing comprehensive technical services alongside product sales to meet specific customer requirements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is recognized as one of the leading PCB manufacturers in China, ranking 26th among the top 100 PCB companies nationally and 35th globally according to industry reports. It competes with other domestic and international PCB producers, leveraging its technological capabilities and product quality to maintain a strong market position in mid-to-high-end PCB segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Shengyi Electronics achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.69 billion, representing a 43.19% increase year-over-year, and a net profit of RMB 331.97 million, successfully returning to profitability. The company’s total assets reached RMB 7.69 billion, with steady growth driven by product structure optimization and expanded production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shengyi Electronics emphasizes high precision, high density, and high reliability in its PCB products, catering to demanding applications such as AI servers, high-speed networking, and automotive electronics. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced manufacturing technologies, strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive quality management systems, and close collaboration with leading customers to deliver customized, high-performance PCB solutions.
